builder.intro.p1: This builds a character for Fractured Earth, one step at a time. Nothing here can break: the draft saves itself, and Back takes you to any step you have already done.
builder.intro.p2: Some steps roll dice — your youth and your careers. Life happens: what you get is part of the story, not a mistake. When a step asks you to choose, the gold notes show what helps the class you are aiming for.
builder.intro.p3: At the end you get your sheet. At the table, the GM can write your backstory and make your portrait. It takes about 15–20 minutes.
builder.intro.title: Making your character

trade.quarterPrice: Registered (bought officially): a quarter of the list price. Corporate gear is built to age fast.
trade.title: Trade
trade.trashConfirm: Drop one {item}? It's gone for good.
trade.unfenceable: Can't be fenced: nobody on the street will touch it.
turn.abilitiesHint: Abilities are used from your class engine below — they roll your Class TN{tn} and spend an action.
turn.attackHint: Roll to hit with the weapon in hand. Choose Body or ⌖ Location inside the roll window.
turn.idle: Not in combat — actions are only logged.
turn.locatedHint: −4 TN. Rolls where it lands; if it gets through armor it adds a condition (broken arm, prone, slowed…).
turn.moveHint: Move up to your squares (Prone halves them; difficult terrain costs double).
turn.noneLeft: No actions left — end the round, or dodge using next round's actions.
turn.swapHint: Only the weapon in hand can attack.
turn.tipsHint: Show or hide the short description under each action (remembered on this device).
turn.title: Turn
twd.buy: No drone: the market sells them (every Tech Wizard starts with a Scrap Drone).
twd.noMods: No drone mods yet: the market sells them.
twd.pick: Pick your drone: the barrier and the sentry turret are made of it.
twd.reachNote.one: Through your drone: up to {n} square away instead of next to you.
twd.reachNote.other: Through your drone: up to {n} squares away instead of next to you.
twd.title: Drone
twd.wreckHint: Mark it wrecked when it is shot down; repair it with Restock & Repair or between missions.
twd.wreckedNote: Wrecked: half reach, half damage until repaired.
unity.actorHint: The crew is deciding. Whatever they say, the choice stays yours.
unity.tallyHint: The crew measures unity, not morality: going ahead against a crew that objected costs trust.
unity.title: Unity Check
unity.voteHint: Your vote is secret: only the tally is shown.
unity.voted: You voted: {vote}. You can change it until the GM reveals.
use.nothing: No usable items. Buy stims, kits and the like in the market.
use.onAlly: On an ally next to me
use.storyDone: Logged: tell the GM what you do with it.
use.storyHint: Writes a line in your log; the GM decides what happens.
use.tellThem: Tell them: they enter it on their own sheet.
washer.terms: {rate} cash per CRS point · commission {commission}% · up to {max} points
washer.title: A fixer’s offer
washer.toast: A fixer makes you an offer — see Gear.
washer.why.below: Credit Score can’t go below 0 this way.
weapons.fistsHint: An empty slot is your fists. Pick a weapon above to ready it.
weapons.noSpares: No spare magazines: buy some, or ask the GM.
weapons.none: No weapons in inventory — your fists for now. Buy one in Gear.
weapons.pick: Pick a weapon from your inventory.
weapons.takeHint: Free out of combat; in combat a swap takes 1 action.
weapons.title: Weapons
weapons.unusable.oneArm: Broken arm: you can use only one one-handed weapon.
whisper.hint: Whisper to the GM: only the GM reads it
whisper.placeholder: e.g. I pocket the keycard while nobody is looking.
whisper.private: Only the GM reads this. Nothing goes in your log.
whisper.title: Whisper to the GM
wmod.hint: Out of a fight, a Soldier or a Tech Wizard installs and removes mods for free; one of each kind per weapon. A modded weapon is its own item: its mods go with it.
wmod.noneCarried: None that fit: the market sells them (Weapon mods).
wmod.title: Weapon mods
